data.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts
data.description: ETF experts say Nvidia’s leadership turmoil and Democratic control of Congress could shift AI demand to the benefit of other Big Tech stocks, rival chipmakers.
